node.title: Re^2: Printing POD info to terminal window without exiting
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
system(qq{perldoc $0});

Sorry, but no. I have much respect for TIMTOWTDI, but given that [doc://Pod::Usage] has been in the Perl core for over 20 years and the question was already solved in the OP, then a solution that calls an external program that may not be installed, is brittle in other ways (PATH and [doc://$0]), doesn't do the same thing as the OP is asking, and introduces a potential security vulnerability ([doc://$0] can be assigned to), is the Wrong Way.
